visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a warm indoor living room with wooden slatted walls. A young woman with brown wavy hair and bangs, wearing an oversized white cardigan over a black hoodie, sits on a beige couch looking at her phone. She interacts with someone off-camera, looking up with curious and surprised expressions. To her left, several red festive gift boxes are stacked. (2) The visual shifts to a studio-style setup where the same woman is now wearing a vibrant red sequined sweater. She holds two patterned Guerlain compacts like binoculars against a background of red decorative boxes. This is followed by a series of product close-ups and application shots: she applies a liquid primer to her hand and then her face, opens a luxury cushion foundation, and applies a bold red lipstick. The lighting is bright and flattering. (3) The final sequence shows the woman at a table covered with mahjong tiles. She excitedly reveals a winning hand, gesturing toward the tiles with high energy and a wide smile. The Guerlain products are displayed on the table beside the tiles. Someone reaches in to playfully grab the items, leading to a comedic reaction from the woman.
